svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut from a 1.0 x 1.25 m sheet: body 996 x 996 mm with the same

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: zigzag low edge; five brine tongues 50 mm wide, 210 mm long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the root line; no distillate tongues (cut the tips flush).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the top face matte black (high-temperature, 600 C class),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tongues excluded. Leave the underside bare.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond wick 1 (five strips) under it, as the condenser plates.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Later bend: brine tongues down 90 deg 155 mm from the root line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: it rests on the stage 1 rails and ribs; its corners touch

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the stop blocks. Nothing is fixed to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: paint fully cured (bake at the maker's schedule) before

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it goes in; no paint on the underside.
